value.rationale: This is the natural first nontrivial-degree solution of a new published finite-field polynomial analogue question: every monic quadratic and every field is covered by a complete order-graded subgroup census, not just an arbitrary test slice. Three quotient factorization geometries lead to distinct exact counting laws and a sharp odd-versus-even maximum with exact equality multiplicities. The fact is not supplied by the prior whole-group theorem and can serve as the low-degree benchmark for higher-degree investigations.
